newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Concordia in talks to sell VLCC to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Concordia in talks to sell VLCC to Brazil.

text.p: Swedish shipping company Concordia Maritime AB said on Tuesday it was negotiating to sell a very large crude carrier to the Brazilian state for an offshore project.

"An agreement in principle has been reached between the Brazilian state and the consortium which has bid for the project, but the sale of the vessel is conditional on the boards involved in the project," Concordia said in a statement.
It said the sale, which would happen in spring 1997 at the earliest, would result in a capital gain of 15 million crowns for Concordia Maritime.
